| $f$ | $Y=5$ | $Y=10$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $X=3$ | $\frac{4}{5}$ | $\frac{3}{25}$ |
| $X=6$ | $\frac{1}{25}$ | $\frac{1}{25}$ |

Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Find $\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=6]$ given that $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above and the corresponding conditional expected value is ${\mu }_{Y|6}=\frac{15}{2}.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=x] & =\text{E}[(Y-{\mu }_{Y|x})^{2}\,|\,X=x] \\  & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2} \\  & =[{\sum }_{y}{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

In order to find ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x),$ let's first find the marginal distribution for $X,$ corresponding to the row totals: 

| $f$ | $Y=5$ | $Y=10$ | ${f}_{X}(x)$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=3$ | $\frac{4}{5}$ | $\frac{3}{25}$ | $\frac{23}{25}$ |
| $X=6$ | $\frac{1}{25}$ | $\frac{1}{25}$ | $\frac{2}{25}$ |

The conditional probability mass function of $Y$ given that $X=x$ is

$$
{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)=\frac{f(x,y)}{{f}_{X}(x)}.
$$

Therefore, dividing each joint probability by the corresponding row total, we obtain the conditional probability mass function of $Y$ given that $X=x:$

| ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)$ | $Y=5$ | $Y=10$ |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=3$ | $\frac{20}{23}$ | $\frac{3}{23}$ | $1$ |
| $X=6$ | $\frac{1}{2}$ | $\frac{1}{2}$ | $1$ |

Finally, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=6] & =[{\sum }_{y}{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,6)]-{\mu }_{Y|6}^{2} \\  & =[{5}^{2}\cdot \frac{1}{2}+{10}^{2}\cdot \frac{1}{2}]-{(\frac{15}{2})}^{2} \\  & =\frac{25}{2}+50-\frac{225}{4} \\  & =\frac{25}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
